Loewe Saffrey (レーベ・サフリー) is a soldier of the UFS, a reoccurring character in the Online Universes.

I'll slice you up with my keen blade. Want to lose your ears? Your arms? Or how about your.... Hehehehe, prepare yourself!
Loewe Saffrey



Personality
Loewe is shown to be a sadistic and lewd girl who seems bored with the UFS and would rather join a group, that's more in conflict and against the wall for fun, than the organization she's allied with.

She's also shown to mercilessly kill people after knocking them out or having sex with them, and because of this, combined with her blood knight personality, she's gained a rather infamous and dreaded reputation. Able to fight without fearing death, and able to sleep after a battle without trouble. When it comes to more normal human interactions or romance, less confident, she can be awkward and sometimes gets pulled into trouble.

Appearance
She has blond hair and red eyes.

History
Background
A Human that joined the UFS and volunteered early on for large scale battles, she was significantly contributing to the victory just with the use of a scythe.

The UFS itself struggles to categorize her but because of her usefulness has kept her around and supplied her with additional weapons, even though she is loyal to battle itself and not the UFS.

Timeline TABA
Was "charmed" into joining the Fuuma Organization. However, struggled to show her more human side.

Trying to seduce Fuuma Kotaro, had not shown any results yet. Asking Minasaki and Lilim for help: The duo decided to decorate one of the hideouts in secret for Christmas party, when Kotaro was away to the UFS. Kotaro send Lina back because he had a bad feeling, and Lina demanded to take down the decoration that was completely out of season. Loewe attacked as the bodyguard of the duo but was knocked out, Kotaro returned but was not mad at Loewe, instead punishing only Minasaki and Lilim for chaos in the hideout.

Timeline RPGX
Seen as one of the UFS soldiers, together with Donna Burroughs, send out to bring back Rocca. Their target went on a quest of revenge, out alone into the forest to kill an Invisible Beast. Loewe and Donna allied with a group of Taimanin (Inage Natsu), that checked the water quality in the area and stumbled into the situation. In the end, they were able to save Rocca and defeat the beast running around in the forest.

Some unofficial translations call her Lebe Saffree.
The name Loewe probably comes from the German word Löwe (Lion).
